397992.title: A One-Line Poem Written on the Lawn: Loop + Hole
397992.venue: Hongik University Museum of Contemporary Art, Hongmun Hall
397992.overview: A contemporary show at Hongik University's museum, on the campus that gave Hongdae its name and its art-school character. Free, and a few minutes from the Hongdae nightlife district.

397954.title: IAP Art Lab — Vania Land: ARTPORT, Goods to Declare
397954.overview: Part of Incheon Art Platform's local-partnership programme, playing on customs-declaration language for a port city. The venue is a cluster of 1930s and 40s warehouses in the old open-port quarter, restored as studios and galleries — worth the walk on its own. Free.

398042.title: Heo Na-young: Building a Day
398042.overview: A solo show in a small ground-floor space along the Naksan fortress wall, part of the Seoul city wall trail above Ihwa Mural Village. Free.

398044.title: Park Mi-ran: Songs of Longing
398044.overview: A solo exhibition at Gallery Won in Wonju, the Gangwon city an hour from Seoul by KTX. Free.

398149.title: Lee Ji-sun: A Place We Have Never Been
398149.overview: Lee Ji-sun builds a world out of childhood memory and invention — landscapes where remembered things, lived things and imagined things are layered until the boundary between the real and the unreal stops holding. The subject is what time leaves behind as a person grows. Free, in Gangnam.

398193.title: Kim Hyun-joo: Neo Flower
398193.overview: For Kim Hyun-joo a flower stands for a life: both are finite, both beautiful, both easily damaged. The work started in 2004 when she mistook a sheet of newspaper blowing down the street for a flower. Free, in Gangnam.

397990.title: Texts after the Exhibition
397990.overview: A show in Mullae, the ironworking district where metal workshops and artist studios share the same alleys — the most distinctive art neighbourhood in Seoul and still a working one. Free.

398194.title: Hyeok Art Group: Beyond the Frame — 79th Exhibition
398194.overview: Hyeok was founded in Busan in 1963 and is the longest-running artists' collective in Korea, with a reputation for pushing experiment over settled style. This is its 79th group show, on Dalmaji-gil — the hillside road above Haeundae lined with galleries and cafés. Free.

398043.title: Fictionally Alibi
398043.overview: A show by emerging artists in a gallery built into the pedestrian underpass in front of the Seoul Arts Center. Free, and easy to combine with whatever is on at the main halls above.

393506.title: Tuesday Gugak Stage: Night of Dalgubeol
393506.overview: A regular Tuesday-evening programme of Korean traditional music at the Daegu Arts Center. Dalgubeol is the old name for Daegu. At 2,000 won it is about as cheap as live traditional music gets anywhere in the country.

393939.title: Joseon Night: Gugak × Disco Vol. 2
393939.overview: Traditional Korean instruments played against a disco rhythm section — the second instalment of a crossover series in Gangneung, on the east coast. Not a purist's evening, and not meant to be; it is one of the easier ways into gugak if the classical repertoire feels daunting. 10,000 won.

398148.title: HOYA: Layers of Memory, Traces of Time — Inside Space
398148.overview: HOYA changes both material and subject with each exhibition. A 2022 show used the physical quality of thorns to talk about how people and society hold each other; this one works through the traces time leaves on the relationships worth remembering. Free, in a cinema lobby gallery in central Ulsan.

397989.title: 14th Haechon Mugyeon Calligraphy Exhibition
397989.overview: The 14th annual show from the Haechon calligraphy circle. Korean calligraphy — seoye — is read as much for the pressure and speed of the brush as for the characters themselves, which makes it approachable even without the language. Free.
